documentation.text: @dev Set when an execution succeeded without the rules this suite checks (should stay false).

@dev A whole proposal in one step (propose, approvals by a random subset of seats, queue, a random wait,
      execute), so that executions happen often enough for the rules below to be exercised.

typeDescriptions.typeString: function (uint256) view external returns (struct PowerShares.Proposal memory)
function (uint256) view external returns (struct PowerShares.Proposal memory)

documentation.text:
@notice Drives PowerShares with random proposals, approvals, revocations, cancels, waits and executions from the
         three seats and outsiders, and records what each successful execution had behind it.
@notice Weights add up to 100 % at most.
@notice No role ever weighs half or more.
@notice Exactly two super-permission seats, both held, never by the same account.
@notice The system seat never holds the veto nor its recovery key; the two veto keys stay distinct.

@notice Every executed change had the veto (or, for a veto change, V's recovery key and 90 days) and the
         timelock behind it.
@notice The epoch counts the executions: nothing executed twice, nothing replayed.
@notice The rules of the share of power hold whatever happens.
